# Adversarial review — the heartbeat-refresh horizon cliff
Semantic pattern: **sequential recovery with stale-write rejection** -> visual type: **flowchart** * a handler longer than the refresh horizon * verified at HEAD `ac770f7` + F15-audit composition follow-up
CONTROLLER A A claims the task lease + heartbeat, generation N A's handler runs past the horizon heartbeat refresher exits PERMANENTLY (lease refresh + heartbeat, owner-guarded) lease goes stale task becomes reclaimable A's handler finally returns late commit attempt CONTROLLER B (RECOVERY) B reclaims the lease generation++ — new owner (fence) NO_SIGNAL → FAILED → requeue recovery ladder (IDR-029 Decision 4) exactly one claim row B re-executes → SUCCEEDED attempt 2 · exactly-once via the ladder A's late commit is DISCARDED IDR29-02 binding guard fires "task already SUCCEEDED; recovery owns it" late write attempt fence is the backstop Tick ends: no succeeded / retried / failed outcome; claims stay 1 The binding guard fires BEFORE the generation fence: the acceptance path's status read sees B's terminal SUCCEEDED and refuses — the fence is the backstop if the read ever saw RUNNING (verified: test_15_f15_horizon_cliff_late_handler_discarded).
## Provenance manifest — diagram source  
| Item | Value |  
| --- | --- |  
| Repository commit | Hermes `ac770f7` (clean tree) |

| Files inspected | `src/hermes/research/controller.py` (`_refresh_liveness` — lease + heartbeat owner-guarded, horizon-exhaustion permanent exit, NO_SIGNAL ladder, IDR29-02 binding guard, generation fence, F15-audit: the NO_SIGNAL->FAILED second-miss hop is ACTIVE-mode-gated so a worker that dies while parked/stopped is requeued after the verdict, and the dispatch claim fails closed on a raced task instead of crashing), `src/hermes/research/controller.py` (`DEFAULT_HEARTBEAT_REFRESH_HORIZON = 300.0`) |  
| Architecture documents | `hermes_p2_residuals_governance.md` (P2 #4 accepted design), IDR-029 (Decision 4 recovery), verdict record (sharp probe at post-F15 HEAD) |  
| Tests | `test_15_f15_horizon_cliff_late_handler_discarded` (A-side: late return discarded, claims stay 1), `test_15_f15_hung_worker_recovered_after_horizon` (B-side: attempt 2, exactly one claim), `test_14_f15_live_worker_lease_protected` * F15-audit composition (post-fix): `test_21_f15_heartbeat_cliff_operator_during_transition` (operator resolves the gate mid-transition: one verdict + one completion, attempt 2), `test_21_f15_paused_recovery_stays_no_signal_completes_after_resume` (PAUSED keeps the worker NO_SIGNAL; chain completes exactly once after resume), `test_21_f15_rejected_gate_wave_stops_recovery_still_completes` (REJECTED gate: wave stops once, recovery still completes), `test_21_f15_paused_revert_fresh_heartbeat_no_requeue` (mode-independent liveness revert: NO_SIGNAL + fresh heartbeat returns to RUNNING even while paused), `test_21_f15_rejected_gate_wave_redispatch_downstream` (the wave re-dispatches an independent task past the FAILED gate), `test_21_f15_operator_resolve_racing_recovery_first_miss` (the operator verdict races B's mid-recovery tick loop: exactly one verdict, no FAILED hop precedes the HumanGateResolved event, recovery completes once at attempt 2), `test_21_f15_recovery_before_dispatch_same_tick` (recovery-before-dispatch pinned by journal order in one tick: every ext-1 hop precedes every ext-2 hop, ext-1 carries the RETRYING hop, ext-2 never does), `test_21_f15_second_gate_reparks_wave` (gate-1 REJECTED returns ACTIVE, gate-2 re-parks AWAITING_HUMAN in the same tick as the recovery; each gate exactly one verdict, zero cross-talk), `test_21_f15_recovery_before_dispatch_dep_edge` (dep-edge same-tick ordering: ext-2 F-10-gated on ext-1, every ext-1 hop precedes every ext-2 hop in journal order), `test_21_f15_rejected_verdict_race_retryable_task` (REJECTED verdict races the mid-recovery tick loop on a retryable worker: one GateFailed, retry re-executes once at attempt 2, no FAILED hop before the verdict), `test_21_f15_resolve_race_outcome_invariant_across_schedules` (property-style: six seeded random schedules all yield one verdict + one completion, no FAILED before verdict), `test_21_f15_recovery_before_dispatch_gate_dep` (dep-edge gate ordering: the requeued worker is a HUMAN_GATE's dependency, so the gate parks WAITING_HUMAN only after recovery — every ext-1 hop precedes every gate hop, one HumanApprovalRequested), `test_21_f15_rejected_verdict_race_retries_exhausted` (REJECTED races the mid-recovery tick loop on an exhausted worker: worker lands FAILED at attempt 1, zero RETRYING hops, wave stops), `test_21_f15_second_gate_property_schedules` (property-style re-park: five seeded schedules all yield two HumanGateResolved, one GateFailed + one GatePassed, one completion at attempt 2), `test_21_f15_recovery_before_dispatch_chained_gates` (chained-gate dep ordering: gate-1 depends on the requeued worker, gate-2 depends on gate-1 — gate-2's park is transitively gated on the recovery; every ext-1 hop precedes every gate-1 hop, every gate-1 hop precedes every gate-2 hop, two HumanApprovalRequested, two GatePassed, zero GateFailed), `test_21_f15_exhausted_retry_race_property_schedules` (property-style exhausted-retry race: five seeded schedules all yield worker FAILED at attempt 1, one HumanGateResolved + one GateFailed, zero GatePassed), `test_21_f15_resolve_race_stall_is_surfaced_not_masked` (bounded-completion liveness: a lease holder confirmed at the verdict leaves the worker NO_SIGNAL, and the completion budget FAILS LOUDLY — STALLED — never masking a stalled chain), `test_21_f15_recovery_before_dispatch_chained_gates_rejected` (chained-gate REJECTED re-park: gate-1 APPROVED, gate-2 REJECTED returns ACTIVE, gate-3 re-parks — every ext-1 hop precedes every gate-1 hop, every gate-1 hop precedes every gate-2 hop, every gate-2 hop precedes every gate-3 hop, three HumanApprovalRequested, two GatePassed + one GateFailed), `test_21_f15_resolve_race_partial_lease_stall_surfaced` (partial-lease stall surfacing: worker recovers, a downstream claim stays blocked by a holder armed after the recovery, and the bounded budget surfaces the DOWNSTREAM stall — STALLED naming ext-2), `test_21_f15_chained_gates_property_schedules` (property-style chained gates: five seeded schedules all yield two verdicts, two gate parks, one recovery at attempt 2), `test_21_f15_chained_gates_rejected_property_schedules` (property-style REJECTED re-park: five seeded schedules all yield gate-1 APPROVED, gate-2 REJECTED returning ACTIVE, gate-3 re-parked and APPROVED, three verdicts, three parks, one recovery), `test_21_f15_resolve_race_third_gate_partial_lease_stall_surfaced` (third-gate partial-lease stall: worker recovers, the second downstream hop AND the third gate stay blocked, and the budget names ext-mid + ext-3 in the STALLED message), `test_21_f15_completion_budget_deep_wide_graph_not_a_false_stall` (completion-budget dependency-graph DoS lens: a fixed 30-tick budget is exhausted by a legitimately deep/wide graph — false STALLED with the byte-identical held-lease clause; the graph-scaled default budget completes the same graphs), `test_21_f15_completion_budget_mixed_mesh_depth_x_width` (mixed depth-x-width mesh lens: 5x8 and 8x5 meshes both need 40 ticks at cap 1 — the requirement is the PRODUCT, not the shape; a fixed 35-tick budget false-STALLs both naming the healthy deepest level, the graph-scaled budget completes both), `test_21_f15_third_gate_partial_lease_stall_property_schedules` (property-style third-gate stall: five schedules, varied resolve pacing AND completion budgets, all surface STALLED naming ext-mid + ext-3, never the recovered worker), `test_21_f15_completion_budget_huge_fan_scaled_never_exhausted` (huge dependency-fan lens: 300 independent extracts need 38 ticks at cap 8 — fixed 30 false-STALLs naming wide-300; the graph-scaled budget is sized to the fan and is un-exhaustable by width; the STALLED message cannot distinguish the false positive from a genuine lease), `test_21_f15_completion_budget_mesh_exact_product_boundary` (product-boundary pin: (5,8) / (8,5) both 40 and (6,6) = 36 complete at budget EXACTLY depth*width with ticks-used == product and false-STALL at product-1 — the requirement is EXACTLY the product, neither under- nor over-sized), `test_21_f15_completion_budget_deep_fan_chain_total_nodes` (widening fan tree, fan-out at every level: a (4,3) tree of 40 nodes and a (3,4) tree of 21 nodes each need THEIR OWN total — the requirement is the TOTAL NODE COUNT of the specific tree; false-STALL at total-1, complete under the node-scaled budget), `test_21_f15_completion_budget_huge_fan_headroom_measured` (headroom measurement: the 300-task fan completes in EXACTLY 38 ticks at cap 8 (ceil(300/8)) against the graph-scaled budget 10 + check-set(2) + 300 = 312 — headroom 274 ticks (~7x) documented; only a genuine lease can trip the scaled budget), `test_21_f15_completion_budget_mixed_shape_mesh_sum_of_depths` (non-uniform mesh pin: per-chain depths differ - (2,5,7) / (1,3,5,7) / (3,6,9) each need SUM(depths) ticks at cap 1 (14/16/18); false-STALL at sum-1, complete at EXACTLY sum; the uniform max x width product is NOT the requirement for a mixed shape), `test_21_f15_stalled_message_names_blocking_owner_row` (STALLED blocking-owner discriminator: the raise snapshots scheduler_lock - a genuine held-lease stall names the holder (controller-*, with locked_at) while a healthy deep/wide false STALL reports the lock FREE; the causal clause stays byte-identical, the owner snapshot is the discriminator), `test_21_f15_completion_budget_headroom_cap_sweep` (cap sweep: the 300-task fan needs ceil(300/cap) ticks at EVERY cap (1..300), the scaled budget stays 312, headroom is positive at every cap - only a genuine stall can trip it; fixed needed-1 false-STALLs and exact-needed completes at caps 1 and 8), `test_21_f15_completion_budget_mixed_mesh_gate2_rejected` (mixed-mesh x REJECTED-gate-2 interleave: gate-2 parks WAITING_HUMAN on gate-1 SUCCEEDED and stops the wave, the operator REJECTS it -> ACTIVE, then the mesh chains dispatch one hop/tick - ticks used == 1 + sum(depths), a sum(depths) budget false-STALLs naming the deepest mesh level, journal order pins ext-1 hops < gate-2 hops < mesh hops), `test_21_f15_stalled_owner_snapshot_lease_handoff` (lease-handoff probe: the STALLED snapshot is a single atomic SELECT of the live scheduler_lock row - every pre-handoff snapshot names the same holder, a mid-stall handoff is named by every post-handoff snapshot AND the final message; the newest locked_at owner is authoritative, the causal clause stays identical), `test_21_f15_completion_budget_unified_closed_form` (UNIFIED closed form: T = depth + wide + md*mw + sum(depths) + fan_total ticks at cap 1, scaled budget = max(30, 10 + len(check_tasks) + T) for EVERY shape and any COMBINED graph; shape table pins ticks==T, budget==the closed form, T-1 false-STALLs, T completes), `test_21_f15_mixed_mesh_gate2_rejected_races_lease_holder` (gate-2 verdict racing a HELD lease: the holder is armed the instant gate-2 parks, the REJECTED resolve is refused LOCK every attempt, gate-2 stays WAITING_HUMAN and the mesh never dispatches - the budget surfaces BOTH the downstream stall (gate-2 + mesh tails, never the recovered worker) AND the lease via the owner snapshot; the same graph without the holder completes - the lease is what turns it into a surfaced stall, never a mask), `test_21_f15_stalled_owner_snapshot_double_handoff` (DOUBLE lease handoff: two owner changes mid-stall - snapshots name holder then handoff-1 then handoff-2, and the final STALLED message names ONLY the newest owner (handoff-2, newest locked_at), never the holder or the intermediate - the atomic SELECT reads the live row, the newest locked_at owner is authoritative even across two successive handoffs) |  
| Node status | All nodes **IMPLEMENTED** ; the discard path is the tested real order (binding guard before fence) |
